title: Bind Claude model and effort launch selection
description: Objective: make the real Claude launcher prove which provider/model/effort/profile/config selection it actually launches. Deliverable: an exact launch-selection contract and pre-open verifier composed into ClaudeLaunchRequest snapshotting and launchClaude so selectedModelId, dated snapshot/build evidence, reasoning effort, profile revision, configuration/policy/orchestration digests, and concurrency ceiling cannot disagree with argv or be supplied only after the run. Consumer: task-159f4c21ef9149e8a65f24735c9c1475. NOT in scope: parsing provider result usage, benchmark records, daemon dispatch, pricing, or treating runtime version/profileRevisionId as model evidence. Owned paths: focused packages/runner/src/providers/claude selection module/bridge/tests and minimal claude-launcher contract/input/entry wiring. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: ClaudeLaunchRequest snapshot carries an exact frozen launch selection distinct from runtime/profile facts, including provider, selected model ID, explicit snapshot/build evidence or UNKNOWN, reasoning effort, profile revision, configuration/policy/orchestration digests, and a positive concurrency ceiling.

Before runtime preparation, grant consumption, lock acquisition, or boundary open, production launchClaude verifies a unique exact argv model/effort selection against the snapshotted contract; duplicate, missing, alias-only, accessor/proxy, or conflicting evidence refuses with a stable exact TELEMETRY_CONFIGURATION code/layer and zero downstream effect.

Runtime reportedVersion/closure and profileRevisionId remain separately bound and can never satisfy model snapshot/build or reasoning-effort fields; dated exact model evidence is preserved while unavailable snapshot evidence is explicit UNKNOWN.
Focused production-path tests assert every selection evidence arm has non-zero exact cardinality, pin code/layer and downstream cutoffs, and mutation-check model and effort comparisons independently.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test exits 0.
taskRails: Do not infer model or effort solely from caller telemetry, environment defaults, settings aliases, runtime reportedVersion, or profileRevisionId.
Selection validation happens before provider/open authority and never echoes argv secrets in refusals.
Do not grow claude-launcher-lifecycle.ts or claude-launcher-port-results.ts; both are already at the 250-line target.

implementationPlan.description: TDD RED for the selection module. (2) The verifier `verifyLaunchSelection(selection, argv)` accepts argv that carries exactly one model flag whose value string-EQUALS selectedModelId and exactly one effort flag whose value equals reasoningEffort. (3) It refuses CLAUDE_LAUNCH_MODEL_UNPROVEN when no model flag is present, CLAUDE_LAUNCH_MODEL_AMBIGUOUS when the model flag appears more than once (whether the values agree or not — duplicate evidence is not evidence), and CLAUDE_LAUNCH_MODEL_MISMATCH when the single value differs from selectedModelId, which is also how an ALIAS-ONLY argv value is refused since an alias never string-equals a dated exact id. (5) CLAUDE_LAUNCH_SELECTION_MALFORMED for a selection that does not snapshot. (6) NO refusal message, and no field of any refusal, contains any argv element, the selected model id, the effort value, or any digest — assert over the JSON-serialized refusal, not just the message. (7) A dated exact model evidence value is preserved verbatim while unavailable snapshot evidence is the explicit literal UNKNOWN and never gains authority. (8) Any swept table carries a hand-written non-zero cardinality assertion plus a `ran` counter checked against it. Run and record the red.

The verifier examines launchSelection and argv but not request.environment, while the request environment is forwarded to the provider at lines 204-205. Claude's documented CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL overrides other effort-setting methods, so an environment value `low` can defeat a claimed/argv `high`. Refuse any effective-effort conflict at TELEMETRY_CONFIGURATION with the exact stable reason and zero boundary/provider effects; add the production launch regression.

Production probes accepted transparent Proxy launchSelection and argv values; an ownKeys trap executed once and the selection still returned ok:true. A hostile selectedModelId object also caused String(...) coercion to invoke a throwing toString and escape. Reject proxies/hostile descriptors before reflective access or coercion, contain revoked/throwing traps, and assert the exact TELEMETRY_CONFIGURATION code/layer on the production surface.
